key_point: Rockstar simulated horses down to their testicles, and players grow attached
title: In Red Dead Redemption 2, horse testicles shrink in cold weather.
caption: In Red Dead Redemption 2, horse testicles shrink in cold weather. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #reddeadredemption2 #rdr2 #rockstargames

instagram.caption:
In Red Dead Redemption 2, horse testicles shrink in cold weather and return to normal when it warms up.

It's one of hundreds of horse details. They get dirty, leave droppings, and bond with you the more you ride, feed and brush them.

That's also why it hurts so much to lose one. If your horse dies and you can't revive it, it's gone for good.

Did you ever lose a horse in RDR2?
